description: Change a DRAFT before publication: customer, line items, due date, discount, tax or memo (give only what changes; `discount: null` / `tax: null` removes one). It creates a new revision, and any pending publication approval for the old one is cancelled. Published invoices can't be edited.

anyOf.description: Only if the merchant asked for one.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, advanced: your own key for this exact request. Leave it out normally: a retry of an unresolved request is resumed automatically.

invoice.description: The invoice id (inv_…) or its number (WF-1042).

anyOf.description: Only a tax the merchant explicitly named, with its rate. Never infer one.

name: update_invoice_draft
title: Update invoice draft
